verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a dedicated reconciliation report suite. It covers balances, fee categories, financial actions, invoices and settlements, and includes a Settlement Breakdown Report, a Payouts Report and a Financial Actions by Payout ID Report that tie payouts to the underlying transactions. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the reports itemize refunds and chargebacks line by line, explicit matching of payouts to bank-deposit records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks

citations.quote: You can reconcile your balances, fee categories, financial actions, invoices, and settlements
Balance Breakdown Report, Balance Report, Financial Actions by Date Range Report, Financial Actions by Payout ID Report, Payouts Report, Settlement Breakdown Report, Settlement Statement
